blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable extraction of calcium-dependent fluorescence traces in calcium imaging sequences requires identifying pixels whose fluorescence intensity reflects the same underlying cellular activity. We present a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation in which temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions. Starting from a fuzzy-neighborhood graph and spectral initialization, we optimize a class-balanced cross-entropy objective using exact sparse attraction and a deterministic particle-mesh decomposition of the dense repulsive interaction with sparse edge compensation, avoiding stochastic negative sampling. The resulting latent representation is spatially decoded into reliable source supports for trace extraction without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior. Experiments on synthetic and in vivo two-photon calcium imaging data demonstrate robust recovery of irregular and spatially touching sources together with efficient deterministic embedding optimization.
blocks.zh: 可靠地提取钙成像序列中依赖钙的荧光痕迹,需要识别其荧光强度能反映同样细胞内活动的像素. 我们提出一个定时嵌入框架,将视像素荧光追踪到一个低维代表,即时间上一致的来源形成空间上一致的区域。 从模糊-邻线图和光谱初始化开始,我们利用精确的稀疏吸引力和确定性粒子-微粒分解的密集反感相互作用与稀疏的边缘补偿来优化一个类平衡的交叉切入目标,避免了扭曲的负取样. 由此产生的潜在表述在空间上解码为可靠的源支持,用于微量提取,而不事先施加明显的细胞形状。 关于合成和活性双光子钙成像数据的实验表明,对不规则和空间接触源的强力恢复以及高效的确定嵌入优化。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Calcium imaging enables the observation of intracellular calcium dynamics across
large populations of cells and provides a widely used readout of cellular activity.
Downstream biological analysis requires determining a reliable fluorescence or
calcium activity trace associated with each underlying cellular source.
Accurate and reproducible source support estimation for trace extraction is therefore
a central step from raw calcium imaging data to quantitative analysis of cellular
dynamics.

blocks.en:
Existing calcium imaging trace extraction methods can generally be classified into
three categories.
First, widely used ROI- and clustering-based methods identify active
cellular regions and subsequently extract their temporal signals ( e.g . ,
PCA/ICA-based cell sorting [ 1 ] ,
Suite2p [ 2 ] , and MIN1PIPE [ 3 ] ).
A second category of methods formulates source extraction as a spatio-temporal
decomposition problem.
Constrained nonnegative matrix factorization (CNMF) [ 4 ] ,
CNMF-E [ 5 ] , and CaImAn [ 6 ] jointly
estimate spatial footprints, temporal components, and background activity, and are
particularly effective when their source and background models match the imaging
modality.
Third, more recently, deep learning methods have been used to learn spatio-temporal
features for neuron detection and segmentation directly from calcium imaging
sequences ( e.g . , STNeuroNet [ 7 ] , SUNS [ 8 ] ,
and DeepWonder [ 9 ] ).
These methods have improved automation, scalability, and segmentation accuracy,
but they generally rely on spatial source models, on morphology learned from
annotated or simulated neurons, or on assumptions tailored to commonly studied
neuronal imaging settings.

blocks.en:
Here, we consider two-photon calcium imaging data of glioblastoma cells, in which
active cellular sources may be irregular, elongated, branching, curved, heterogeneous
in brightness, and frequently touching or spatially connected
( cf . Fig. 1 (a,b)).
In such data, a static or maximum-intensity projection may merge distinct cells,
and morphology alone is generally insufficient to define source identity.
In contrast, pixels belonging to the same active cell often exhibit a common blinking
pattern over time, whereas neighboring cells can display distinct and asynchronous
temporal dynamics.
This motivates treating source identification as a high-dimensional temporal
representation problem rather than as a purely spatial image segmentation problem.
In our preliminary work, we noticed that UMAP [ 10 ] applied
directly to raw pixel-wise fluorescence traces produced remarkably compact latent
regions corresponding to blinking cells, with neighboring cells often mapped to distinct
latent values even when being in direct spatial contact ( cf . Fig. 1(c) ).
However, standard UMAP uses stochastic low-dimensional optimization, which is
undesirable when the embedding itself serves as the basis for reproducible downstream
source extraction.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce a deterministic temporal embedding framework inspired by
UMAP for calcium imaging trace extraction.
Pixel-wise raw fluorescence traces are represented by complementary Euclidean and
cosine fuzzy-neighborhood graphs, which are adaptively fused to retain both waveform
and amplitude information.
Starting from a spectral initialization used in UMAP, we optimize a class-balanced
cross-entropy objective in which sparse graph attraction is computed exactly, while
the dense repulsive interaction is decomposed into a global particle-mesh (PM) field
and an exact sparse edge compensation term.
This formulation avoids stochastic negative sampling and enables deterministic
low-dimensional optimization.
The resulting latent representation is decoded into spatially coherent candidate source
supports, which are then selected based on temporal activity, without imposing an
explicit cellular shape prior.
Experiments on synthetic data with ground truth and real in vivo calcium imaging
data demonstrate robust recovery of irregular and spatially touching sources
and reliable extraction of their fluorescence traces.

blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Temporal fuzzy graph and spectral initialization
blocks.zh: 2.1 时间模糊图和光谱初始化

blocks.en:
We start from the raw fluorescence trace of each spatial pixel in an image
sequence of T T frames.
No temporal centering or spatial smoothing is applied, as both operations can
suppress or mix source-specific temporal structure.
We construct fuzzy neighborhood graphs from the raw traces using the
standard UMAP neighborhood construction [ 10 ] with 15 nearest neighbors.
Two graphs are computed independently, using Euclidean and cosine
distance.
The Euclidean graph retains amplitude-dependent information, whereas
the cosine graph emphasizes waveform similarity and is less sensitive to
multiplicative intensity variation within a source.
The proposed representation combines these complementary relationships.

Following the spectral initialization used in UMAP, we use a D D -dimensional

This provides a reproducible coarse graph organization before the subsequent
low-dimensional optimization and avoids introducing random large-scale
structure at initialization.

blocks.en:
While the theoretical UMAP objective compares high- and low-dimensional
fuzzy memberships through a binary cross-entropy, a sampling-based
objective is optimized in practice.
As shown in [ 11 ] , this sampling procedure substantially
changes the effective loss and, importantly, implicitly balances the sparse
attractive interactions against the much larger population of repulsive pairs.

In contrast to [ 13 ] , in which a repulsive field is constructed
to mimic the aggregate behavior of UMAP’s stochastic optimizer,
our PM method is based on the explicit objective in Eq. ( 2 ), with
the attraction–repulsion structure and PM–sparse decomposition analytically
derived from it.

吸引力-推力结构和PM-sparse分解分析

blocks.en: 2.3 Spatial support and trace extraction
blocks.zh: 2.3 空间支持和微量提取

blocks.en:
The D D -dimensional latent coordinates are mapped back to their image
locations to form a spatial latent field.
Since the resulting field is typically smooth within sources but changes
sharply across source boundaries ( cf . Fig. 1(d) ),
useful supports can be recovered with a relatively simple spatial decoder.
In this work, we use mean-shift segmentation [ 14 ] followed by merging of adjacent regions with similar latent representations,
as one practical implementation rather than a core component of the
embedding method.
The specific decoder can be replaced by other segmentation methods.
blocks.zh:
DD维度潜伏坐标被映射回他们的图像
位置以形成空间潜伏场。
由于由此产生的字段在源内通常平滑但变化
急剧跨越源边界(参见图1(d)),
用相对简单的空间解码器可以回收有用的支持.
在这项工作中,我们采用平均轮班划分[14],然后合并具有类似潜在表述的邻近区域,
作为《公约》的一项实际执行,而不是作为《公约》的核心组成部分
嵌入法.
具体的解码器可以被其他分解方法取代.

blocks.en:
Candidate supports are subsequently selected and ranked using a short-lag
positive autocorrelation (ACF) activity feature, motivated by previous use
in calcium imaging to distinguish signal-bearing
components from noise [ 15 ] .
The ACF is used only as a post-embedding activity measure and is not part
of the embedding optimization.
Finally, the fluorescence trace of each accepted source is obtained as the
frame-wise mean intensity over its selected support.

阳性自动连接( ACF) 活动特性, 由以前使用所激发
在钙成像中区分含信号
来自噪声的组件 [15].
ACF仅用作嵌入后的活动措施,不属于其中
的嵌入优化。
最后,每个接受来源的荧光微量作为
相对于其选定的支持,框架平均强度。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en:
Data. We evaluated the method on a synthetic dataset and an in vivo calcium imaging
sequence.
The synthetic data consists of a sequence of 44 irregular cells with 180 frames
of 256 × \times 256 pixels, including isolated and touching cells, heterogeneous
shapes and fluorescence patterns, asynchronous calcium events, static distractors,
and multiple noise sources (Fig. 2 (a,b)).
The in vivo data was acquired using a multiphoton microscope from an awake,
head-fixed NMRI-nude mouse with a chronic cranial
window [ 16 , 17 ] and implanted BG5 glioblastoma cells
expressing GCaMP7b and tdTomato [ 18 ] .
The image sequence consists of 980 frames of 512 × \times 512 pixels with
a spatial resolution of 0.59 µ ​ m 0.59\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m} per pixel and a frame interval
of 0.94 s 0.94\text{\,}\mathrm{s} (Fig. 1 (a,b)).
We employed the GCaMP7b (green) channel for analysis.

Results on synthetic data. We studied three variants of our method using Euclidean, cosine, and adaptive fused
temporal graphs (PM-Euclidean, PM-Cosine, and PM-Adaptive) and performed a
comparison with Suite2p [ 2 ] and
CaImAn [ 6 ] .
Predicted and ground-truth source supports were matched one-to-one by the
Hungarian algorithm using an IoU threshold of 0.30.
We report F1 score and recall for all cells and for the subset of touching cells.
Recall quantifies source-recovery completeness, whereas F1 additionally penalizes
false positives.

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 1 , PM-Adaptive achieved the best
overall F1 score while recovering all ground-truth cells.
PM-Euclidean also reached perfect recall (1.000), but its lower F1 score indicates
more false positives.
PM-Cosine reduced false positives, but missed several cells.
PM-Adaptive avoids this trade-off by combining the complementary information
captured by the Euclidean and cosine temporal graphs.
The advantage was most pronounced for touching cells, where PM-Adaptive
achieved 1.000 for both F1 and recall, substantially outperforming CaImAn
and Suite2p.

The latent representation is subsequently decoded into the extracted supports.

While both methods identify numerous fluorescent structures, PM-Adaptive

This can be attributed to the fact that the proposed method relies primarily on
temporal similarity and does not impose an explicit cellular shape prior during

The extracted traces of the top-ranked PM-Adaptive supports show distinct
transient and sustained fluorescence dynamics across cells.
The support IDs in Fig. 3(b) correspond directly to those in
the trace plot in Fig. 3(c) , illustrating the spatial origin of the
recovered temporal signals.

blocks.en:
Computational efficiency. Using the same adaptive fuzzy graph and spectral initialization, we compared
the time for embedding optimization for the real calcium imaging data.
On a MacBook Pro with an Apple M1 Pro and 16 GB unified memory, UMAP
required 148.3 s 148.3\text{\,}\mathrm{s} , whereas PM-Adaptive required 22.8 s 22.8\text{\,}\mathrm{s} and was about 6.5 times faster.
This gain was obtained with a CPU implementation.
The particle-mesh operations are highly parallelizable and may benefit further
from a GPU implementation.

需要148.3 s 148.3\text~,}\mathrm{s},而PM-Adaptive则需要22.8 s 22.8\text~,}\mathrm{s},速度约6.5倍.
这一收益是通过CPU执行取得的。
颗粒层操作高度平行,可能进一步受益
从GPU执行.

blocks.en: 4 Summary
blocks.zh: 4 总结

blocks.en:
We presented a deterministic temporal embedding framework for calcium imaging
trace extraction that combines adaptive Euclidean–cosine fuzzy graphs with
particle-mesh optimization of a class-balanced cross-entropy objective.
The method separates temporally distinct sources in a low-dimensional latent space
and converts the resulting spatially coherent regions into reliable cellular supports
without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior.
Experiments on synthetic and in vivo data demonstrated robust recovery of irregular
and spatially touching sources together with efficient deterministic optimization.
The strong downstream performance obtained with a simple spatial decoder further
suggests that source separation is achieved primarily in the temporal embedding
rather than through complex spatial post-processing.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了钙成像的定时嵌入框架
将适应性的欧几里得-西锡模糊图与
粒子-mesh 优化一个类平衡的横切目标。
该方法在低维潜在空间中分离时间上不同的源
并将由此产生的空间一致性区域转化为可靠的蜂窝支持
而不事先强制使用明确的细胞形状。
合成和体内数据的实验表明,不规则现象得到强劲恢复
和空间接触源 以及高效的确定优化。
更简单的空间解码器在下游获得了强大的性能
表示主要通过时间嵌入实现源分离
而不是通过复杂的空间后处理。
